questions.question: `.gitlab-ci.yml` da stage va job nima?
questions.explanation: Stage — bosqich (build, test, deploy), ketma-ket ishlaydi. Job — stage ichidagi vazifa; bir stage'dagi job'lar parallel.

questions.question: GitLab Runner va executor nima?
questions.explanation: Runner — job'larni oladigan agent (`gitlab-runner`). Executor — job qayerda ishlashi: `shell`, `docker`, `kubernetes`, `docker-machine`/autoscaler.

questions.question: `variables` va CI/CD variable'lar qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: YAML'dagi `variables:` yoki Settings > CI/CD > Variables. Belgilar: **Protected** (faqat protected branch/tag), **Masked** (log'da yashirin), File turi.

questions.question: `image` va `services` kalitlari nima?
questions.explanation: `image` — job qaysi Docker image ichida ishlashi. `services` — yonidan ko'tariladigan qo'shimcha container (postgres, redis) testlar uchun.

questions.question: Artifact va cache GitLab'da qanday farqlanadi?
questions.explanation: Artifact — job natijasi, keyingi stage'larga avtomatik uzatiladi, yuklab olish mumkin. Cache — dependency tezlashtirish, best-effort, runner'da/S3'da.

questions.question: `before_script`, `script`, `after_script` farqi?
questions.explanation: `before_script` va `script` bitta shell'da ketma-ket, biri yiqilsa job fail. `after_script` alohida shell'da har doim ishlaydi (cleanup), uning xatosi job natijasiga ta'sir qilmaydi.

questions.question: `allow_failure`, `retry` va `timeout` kalitlari?
questions.explanation: `allow_failure: true` — job yiqilsa pipeline davom etadi (sariq). `retry: 2` — infra xatolarida qayta. `timeout` — job uchun maksimal vaqt.

questions.question: Pipeline turlari: branch, tag, MR, scheduled — `CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE` qanday yordam beradi?
questions.explanation: `CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE` qiymatlari: `push`, `merge_request_event`, `schedule`, `web`, `api`, `trigger`, `pipeline`. `rules` bilan qaysi job qaysi pipeline'da ishlashini aniqlaydi.

questions.question: GitLab Container Registry'ga image push qilish?
questions.explanation: Predefined `CI_REGISTRY`, `CI_REGISTRY_USER`, `CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD` (`CI_JOB_TOKEN`), `CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE` bilan login va push.

questions.question: `rules` va eski `only/except` farqi?
questions.explanation: `rules` — tartibli shartlar ro'yxati, birinchi mos kelgani qo'llanadi (`if`, `changes`, `exists`, `when`). `only/except` deprecated, birlashtirish qiyin.

questions.question: `needs` (DAG) stage'lardan nimasi bilan yaxshi?
questions.explanation: `needs` job'ga stage tugashini kutmasdan faqat kerakli job'lar tugashi bilan boshlash imkonini beradi — pipeline vaqti qisqaradi.

questions.question: `include` va `extends` bilan konfiguratsiyani qanday qayta ishlatasiz?
questions.explanation: `include` — boshqa fayl/project/template'ni ulaydi (`local`, `project`, `remote`, `template`, `component`). `extends` — job'ni shablon (`.base`) dan meros qiladi.

questions.question: Environment, `when: manual` va review app'lar?
questions.explanation: `environment:` deploy'ni kuzatadi (tarix, rollback, URL). `when: manual` — tugma bilan. Review app — har MR uchun vaqtinchalik environment, `on_stop` bilan o'chiriladi.

questions.question: Parent-child va multi-project pipeline nima?
questions.explanation: Parent-child — bir repo ichida `trigger: include:` bilan dinamik/alohida child pipeline. Multi-project — boshqa project pipeline'ini trigger qilish (`trigger: project:`).

questions.question: `parallel` va `parallel:matrix` qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: `parallel: N` — bir job'ning N nusxasi (`CI_NODE_INDEX`, `CI_NODE_TOTAL`) — test sharding. `parallel:matrix` — o'zgaruvchi kombinatsiyalari bo'yicha job'lar.

questions.question: `resource_group` va `interruptible` nima uchun?
questions.explanation: `resource_group` — bir resurs (environment) ga bir vaqtda faqat bitta job (deploy navbatda). `interruptible: true` — yangi pipeline kelganda eskisini bekor qilish mumkin.

questions.question: `dependencies` va `needs:artifacts` — artifact oqimini qanday boshqarasiz?
questions.explanation: Default — job oldingi barcha stage artifact'larini yuklaydi. `dependencies: [build]` yoki `needs: [{job: build, artifacts: true}]` — faqat keraklisi; `dependencies: []` — hech biri.

questions.question: `!reference` tag va YAML anchor farqi?
questions.explanation: YAML anchor (`&`, `<<: *`) faqat bitta fayl ichida. `!reference [.job, script]` — `include` qilingan fayllar orasida ham ishlaydi va kalitning bir qismini (masalan script qatorlari) qayta ishlatadi.

questions.question: Scheduled pipeline va pipeline trigger token qanday ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Schedule — UI'da cron, o'z variable'lari bilan (nightly e2e, dependency scan). Trigger token — tashqi tizim API orqali pipeline ishga tushiradi.

questions.question: Protected branch/variable modeli qanday xavfsizlik beradi va qayerda teshik bor?
questions.explanation: Protected variable faqat protected ref pipeline'iga beriladi. Teshik: Developer protected branch nomiga mos branch yarata olsa yoki MR pipeline'da `.gitlab-ci.yml` ni o'zgartirib secret'ni chiqarsa.

questions.question: `CI_JOB_TOKEN` va OIDC `id_tokens` qanday ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: `CI_JOB_TOKEN` — job davomida yashaydigan token, registry/API/boshqa project'ga kirish (allowlist bilan). `id_tokens` — cloud/Vault uchun audience'li JWT, statik key'siz.

questions.question: Katta monorepo'da GitLab pipeline'ni qanday tezlashtirasiz?
questions.explanation: O'lchash (pipeline analytics) > `rules:changes` bilan keraksiz job'ni kesish > `needs` DAG > cache kalitini lockfile'ga bog'lash > parallel/sharding > child pipeline > runner autoscaling.

questions.question: Merge train va merged results pipeline nima muammoni yechadi?
questions.explanation: Merged results — MR'ni target bilan birlashtirilgan holatda test qiladi. Merge train — navbatdagi MR'larni ketma-ket birlashtirib test qiladi, shunda `main` hech qachon qizil bo'lmaydi.

questions.question: Shared runner'larda job izolyatsiyasi va supply chain xavflari?
questions.explanation: Docker executor `privileged: true` (DinD) — container host'ni boshqarishi mumkin. Shared runner'da bir project boshqasining cache/secret'iga yetishi xavfi. Yechim: ephemeral runner, rootless build (kaniko/buildah), sensitive project uchun alohida runner.

questions.question: Runner autoscaling va distributed cache qanday quriladi?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes executor yoki docker-autoscaler (fleeting plugin, AWS ASG) — job yuklamasiga qarab mashina ko'payadi. Ephemeral runner'larda local cache yo'q — S3/GCS distributed cache.

questions.question: GitLab security scanning (SAST, DAST, dependency, secret detection) pipeline'ga qanday qo'shiladi?
questions.explanation: Template'lar `include: template: Jobs/SAST.gitlab-ci.yml` va h.k. Natija MR widget'da. Ultimate'da security policy (scan execution / merge request approval policy) — majburiy qilish.

questions.question: Pipeline'ni debug qilishda `CI_DEBUG_TRACE` nega xavfli?
questions.explanation: `CI_DEBUG_TRACE: true` har buyruqni va **barcha** variable'larni (masked secret'lar ham) log'ga chiqaradi. Log'ni ko'radigan har kim secret'ni oladi.

questions.question: GitLab bilan GitOps/K8s deploy (agent) qanday tashkil qilinadi?
questions.explanation: GitLab agent for Kubernetes (`agentk`) cluster ichida o'rnatiladi va GitLab'ga outbound ulanadi. Variant: CI access (pipeline `kubectl` bilan cluster'ga agent orqali) yoki GitOps (Flux, manifest repo'dan pull).

questions.question: Compliance pipeline / pipeline execution policy nima va qachon kerak?
questions.explanation: Tashkilot darajasida majburiy job'larni (scan, audit, imzo) har project pipeline'iga kiritish — developer ularni o'chira olmaydi. Regulyatsiyali muhitda (PCI DSS, SOC 2) kerak.

questions.question: Self-managed GitLab va runner'larni qanday masshtablash va ishonchli qilish kerak?
questions.explanation: Runner'lar gorizontal (stateless), GitLab o'zi — reference architecture (Gitaly cluster, PostgreSQL HA, Redis, object storage). Artifact/cache/registry — object storage'ga.
